column3: “Desert plain” is rendered “the Arabah,” and the verbs are paired differently.
“Slack hands … stumbling knees” is rendered “the exhausted … the feeble.”
“Hasty of heart” is rendered “with anxious heart,” and “vengeance he will come” as “will come with vengeance.”
“Shout of joy” is rendered “joyful shouting,” and “will overtake” as “will find.”
